name: Chloe Sturges
title: Consultant
quote:
I had the pleasure of collaborating with Mubarak during our Worldwide Kids projects with Incresco. As one of our direct contacts, he demonstrated excellent communication skills, always clear in explaining any issues and highly efficient in resolving them.

Mubarak not only identified and broke down the root causes of problems but also worked hands-on to fix them through coding, testing, and successful deployment into production. It's been a real pleasure working with Mubarak, both professionally and personally. He's a great teammate, and I truly value the successful collaboration we have together.
